limitations: Composable callback literals remain exact zero-argument nonreceiver nonsuspend Unit functions; source composable declarations, nullable/generic/receiver/result-bearing callback shapes remain unsupported in this compiler snapshot

Binary composable calls accept exact public static nongeneric noninline Unit file-facade ABI shapes, with at most64 logical arguments and validated Composer/changed/default tails; source composition control flow and mixed or unrecognized target schemes reject explicitly

Ordinary function creation inside a composable body supports nonanonymous non-SAM nonsuspend Fn0/Fn1 Unit closures; comparisons use changed overloads for scalar/String captures and changedInstance for annotation-free Kotlin interfaces whose interface ancestors also satisfy that bound
Annotated/stable or unknown custom class capture stability, mutable capture cells, conditional memoization and unsupported callback arity/results reject explicitly

Compiled canonical Stable/Immutable class markers and marked ancestors guide supported static singleton/field and Stable-producer flags; runtime StabilityInferred supports parameters=0 with a validated public static final $stable:I field. Dependent generic runtime stability schemes reject explicitly

Source class inferred-stability fields and StabilityInferred tags are not exported. This report does not establish replacement-class ABI for existing compiled Compose consumers or whole-module plugin compatibility

Composer/RecomposeScope are controlled proxies. Actual Runtime1.11.0 composableLambdaInstance wrappers, pinned transformed callees and deferred SideEffect execution run in verified JVMs; real Composition/Recomposer and Android execution remain unassessed

Keys and generated class names are compiler-specific. The changed flags reflect the pinned Kotlin2.3.21 plugin with default strong skipping; runtime masks may differ between same-module app builds and isolated compilation, so the production comparison uses identical filtered classpaths

historical_comparison.before: Binary calls were recognized but ordinary callback creation rejected explicitly, so unchanged222 did not compile
historical_comparison.checkpoint: The first memoization checkpoint compiled222 but passed an incomplete constant changed mask. Runtime/stable argument flags are corrected here; this is an ABI correctness correction rather than an additional source compilation gain
historical_comparison.failed_run_reason: 52groups passed; mutable local capture reached an unclassified preexisting boxing rejection. The current implementation classifies that boundary explicitly inside composable bodies.
